posts.zh:
dsh-stock-terminal 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。股市行情皮肤与功能插件：全局交易终端皮肤 + 跑马灯 + 个股 K 线弹窗（日K/周K/月K 切换）、自选拼音首字母模糊搜索、持仓盈亏管理、交易时段指示，支持 A股 / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币 / 外汇。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-77347f1a4595c297c432.html
posts.en:
dsh-stock-terminal is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-77347f1a4595c297c432.html
